foodSurplus.note: Recomputed 2026-10-29 under the definition: 0.0 -> 0.82. Formula: surplus = 1 - a/s, a = farm population share of consumers (proxy: agricultural employment share, World Bank SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS, ILO modelled, https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/KOR/indicator/SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS), s = domestic production / consumption (calorie self-sufficiency). a = 5.10% (2025). s from FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheets (https://bulks-faostat.fao.org/production/FoodBalanceSheets_E_All_Data.zip): production / domestic supply summed over all FBS items, each weighted by kcal per tonne (world median of food kcal / food tonnes per item); feed, processing and non-food uses stay in domestic supply. s = 0.29 (mean 2021-2023, range 0.28-0.29). Mid 1 - 0.051/0.29 = 0.82. Low: a x 1.3 (farm households larger than the employed count), s 0.28 = 0.76. High: s 0.29 = 0.82. Import dependence: domestic production covers about 29% of domestic calorie supply. Earlier net-trade reading: Educated guess. Food self-sufficiency ~45%; rice self-sufficient, imports grain/feed.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 25,783,559 x share of males aged 15-19 4.617% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 238,060. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with a 2026 order of battle. Population inside ne:KOR. Money via derived:ppp-rebase-2011.
